verdict.rationale: No evidence addresses AI-training data use. The only relevant item says the open-source edition runs in your own infrastructure with full control of your data plane, which indirectly keeps data away from the vendor. That is a workaround, not a stated policy or control. Missing for 10: an explicit no-training policy or opt-out for SigNoz Cloud, documentation of how data flows through the AI features (MCP server and Agent Skills), and independent corroboration.
